messages:
omar: Quick proposal: per-route redact tiers + tenant storage caps. Keep only a small prefix + HMAC fingerprint; never store embeddings or model outputs. Default off per-tenant, opt-in via Console.
lia: Agree on default off. Recommend three tiers: public(64b, 6h), partner(128b, 24h), admin(256b, 72h + breakglass).
ben: Important: enforce per-tenant hourly cap and emit metrics when cap hit so we can fail open to no-retain without slowing inference. Metric names: retention.retained, retention.denied_cap, retention.fallback_nostore.
rachael: UX: show tier badge on route settings and a small "retention usage" card with current window usage and button to request temporary bump. Tooltip text must be compliance-approved.
omar: Implementation sketch: router tags request with route_id and tier; redact middleware applies prefix, strips embeddings, computes tenant-scoped HMAC(fingerprint) using KMS key, store encrypted blob with TTL.
jess: Security: tenant HMAC keys must rotate monthly; include namespace in HMAC input to avoid cross-route collisions. Also require KMS audit logs.
ben: Edge case: when cap hit, fallback to not storing and emit alert to ops channel + increment tenant denials. Need a circuit-breaker to avoid cascade.
lia: Legal/ops: breakglass requires SSO approval, justification, auto-pseudonymize on view and TTL-limited access. Log approver id + reason.
sec-bot: security-scan: missing KMS rotation policy and breakglass RBAC matrix (ticket SEC-4622).
omar: I'll draft RFC with config example + tests (collision probability, cap enforcement, embedding-strip). Will include console mockups and SEC ticket link.
rachael: I'll add the UI copy & screenshots once RFC lands.
jess: +1.
omar: If no blockers I'll open PR next week and schedule canary deploy to earlier canary pool. Follow-ups in this thread.
